title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our Product Engineering team and build the cloud platform behind the modernization of our Retail ERP platform. You will own infrastructure as code, build pipelines, release automation, deployment, monitoring, and recovery on Microsoft Azure.

This role requires strong hands-on Azure and Terraform skills and experience running PostgreSQL at scale. You will work closely with Architects, development teams, and QA to make releases to a large multi-tenant estate safe, repeatable, and fast.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, build, and maintain Azure infrastructure using Terraform (Container Apps, Application Gateway, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Key Vault, networking, and storage).
* Set up and manage CI/CD runners and shared pipeline templates in GitHub Actions for all development teams.
* Build and operate release automation that applies database migrations (Flyway) to a large number of client databases in controlled groups.
* Automate deployment to development, staging, and production environments.
* Set up monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards; take part in on-call during major releases.
* Plan and run backup, restore, and disaster recovery drills; maintain runbooks.
* Manage secrets, access control, and environment security.
* Profile database estates (size, growth, load) and support test environments built from masked data.
* Optimize cloud cost, capacity, and performance.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **Cloud**

* 4+ years of hands-on DevOps / platform engineering experience.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure (Container Apps or AKS, networking, Key Vault, storage, Application Gateway).

### **Infrastructure as Code**

* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including modules, state management, and environment promotion.

### **CI/CD**

* Strong experience with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, including self-hosted runners and reusable pipeline templates.
* Experience automating releases across many environments or tenants.

### **Database Operations**

* Hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL: backup, restore, replication, and performance basics.
* Experience with database migration tools such as Flyway or Liquibase.

### **Containers & Scripting**

* Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized deployments.
* Scripting with Bash, PowerShell, or Python.

### **Monitoring & Security**

* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Azure Monitor, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or similar).
* Good understanding of cloud security, secrets management, and access control.

**Team Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Provide shared pipelines, environments, and standards that development teams can use on their own.
* Review infrastructure changes and enforce best practices.
* Support development teams during releases and production incidents.
* Document infrastructure, runbooks, and processes.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience running multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes (AKS).
* Experience with disaster recovery across regions.
* Comfortable using AI tools to write and review infrastructure code.
* Exposure to retail, ERP, or POS systems.

**Educational Qualification**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* Cloud Platform for an Enterprise Retail ERP
* Infrastructure as Code on Microsoft Azure
* CI/CD and Release Automation
* Database Release Automation across a Multi-tenant Estate
* Monitoring and Observability
* Backup and Disaster Recovery
* Cloud-native Modernization Initiatives

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* Strong hands-on automation mindset.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Care for reliability, security, and repeatability.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering business value.
* Good communication with development teams.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Opportunity to modernize a large-scale enterprise Retail ERP platform.
* Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems.
* Solve challenging scalability and performance problems.
* Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams.
* Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity:**

At Ericsson, we are driving digital transformation through automation, cloud-native technologies, and modern DevOps practices. We are looking for a highly motivated and customer-focused DevOps Engineer who is passionate about automation, CI/CD, infrastructure management, and operational excellence.  
In this role, you will work closely with development, operations, customers, and business stakeholders to design, Create and maintain technical documentation, MOPs, and runbooks Engage independently with customers and stakeholders; lead technical discussions and drive delivery outcomes across multiple projects and environments.  
This position requires strong expertise in scripting, automation, DevOps tools, container platforms, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

**Mandatory Skills**  
Strong Shell scripting (Bash) and Python  
Hands-on experience with Ansible, YAML, and JSON  
GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Git, and Gerrit or similar code review tools  
Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm (OpenShift is a plus)  
Working knowledge of Linux environments  
Monitoring tools such as Grafana or Prometheus  
Agile/Scrum delivery experience

**Good to Have**  
Exposure to Azure, AWS, or GCP  
Jira, Confluence, and ServiceNow (preferred)  
Telecom domain knowledge  
GitOps tools (ArgoCD or FluxCD)  
Kibana or ELK Stack  
VMware, OpenStack, or virtualized infrastructure experience.

**Soft Skills**  
Excellent written and verbal English communication  
Strong stakeholder management and customer-facing experience  
Analytical problem-solving and an ownership mindset  
Ability to mentor junior engineers and work in global teams

title: Enterprise Platform Architect DevOps
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity**

Join our team as an Architect – AI and DevOps, helping define and deliver secure, scalable and cost-effective AI solutions for enterprise environments. You will shape architectural standards and guide the adoption of Generative AI, large language models, intelligent agents and automation across technology platforms and delivery processes.

Working with engineering, product, security and platform teams, you will connect strategic goals with practical solutions that are reliable, maintainable and ready for production.

**What you will do**

Define end-to-end AI and machine learning architectures that meet requirements for performance, availability, security, scalability and cost.  
Design enterprise solutions using large language models, prompt engineering, model tuning, efficient model deployment and secure integration.  
Consulting & Business Generation: Work with Customer Units to propose Automation and AI Solutions & capabilities in the Telecom Service Domain. Contribute to creation of End to end solution, presales estimates and work on Statement of Work and compliance document.  
Architect knowledge solutions using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search.  
Design intelligent agents, tool integrations and workflow orchestration using APIs and the Model Context Protocol.  
Establish standards for automated delivery pipelines covering source control, testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment and validation.  
Design cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes and microservices.  
Guide infrastructure automation, configuration management and Infrastructure as Code using Ansible and related tools.  
Embed privacy, access control, security, compliance and responsible AI practices, including human approval where appropriate.  
Promote effective monitoring, logging, performance improvement and production troubleshooting.  
Communicate architectural decisions clearly and support teams in delivering consistent, high-quality solutions.

**You will bring**

Experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, machine learning, cloud or DevOps solutions.  
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning architecture, deep learning, large language models and modern AI applications.  
Proficiency in Python and practical experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.  
Experience with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases, model integration and performance optimization.  
Knowledge of AI agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, tool calling, API integration and the Model Context Protocol.  
Hands-on experience with Git, Ansible, CI/CD design, Python or Bash scripting, JSON and YAML. GitLab experience is an advantage.  
Familiarity with code quality and security tools, artifact repositories and container registries.  
Experience with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, networking and identity management.  
Knowledge of Ubuntu and Red Hat Enterprise Linux environments, monitoring, logging, observability and production support.  
Strong communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams.

**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**

title: Salesforce Devops
description:
CXCRM Recruitment

Dear Candidate  
Greetings from Cognizant!!

**Job Title:** Salesforce DevOps Developer

**Experience:** 4 to 12 years

**Location:** All CTS Location (3 days office, Hybrid mode)

**Notice Period:** Immediate to 90 days

#### **Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled **Salesforce DevOps Developer** with strong Salesforce development expertise and hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD, version control, and release management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for automating deployments, streamlining development processes, and ensuring high-quality Salesforce releases across environments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement Salesforce DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs.
* Manage source code repositories using Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
* Automate deployments using Salesforce DX (SFDX), Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Perform code reviews and enforce development best practices.
* Manage branching, merging, release strategies, and environment synchronization.
* Work closely with developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth releases.
* Troubleshoot deployment issues and optimize release processes.
* Implement security, compliance, and governance standards across Salesforce environments.
* Support Agile development and DevOps transformation initiatives.
